column1: # Area map: which compiler area a changed path belongs to. scripts/gen/bug_ledger.py reads it to
# derive each bug's area from its fix commits (docs/bugs/AREAS.md; `bug_ledger.py report`).
# This table owns the path -> area mapping and nothing else: no fact about any bug lives here.
#   prefix   a path prefix, matched as a plain string against the repository path a commit
#            touched; the LONGEST matching prefix wins. Paths of the old flat layout
#            (Concrete/Lower.lean before Concrete/IR/) keep their rows: history still names them.
#   tier     code     compiler, stdlib and tooling source: where a fix lives; weighted first
#            gate     gates, the test harness and CI: weighted only when a bug's fix touched no code
#            docs     prose: weighted only when a fix touched neither code nor gates
#            ignore   test programs, fixtures, examples, bug records and generated files: never
#                     weighted (a regenerated view carries no area, so regenerating after a fix
#   stage    Parse Resolve Check Elab Mono Lower SSA EmitSSA EmitLLVM Interp Proof Report Std CLI
#            Tooling Gates Docs, or "-" on an ignore row
#   module   the module the path belongs to, or "*" for the path's own file name without its
# A fix commit that touches a path no row matches stops the ledger generator (exit 2): add a row.
